newsitem.title: GERMANY: Trichet-budgets should be balanced in normal times.
newsitem.headline: Trichet-budgets should be balanced in normal times.

text.p: Bank of France Governor Jean-Claude Trichet said on Tuesday that he agreed with Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer that in normal times countries should have a balanced budget to be able to counter "assymetric shocks" to their economies.
Trichet, speaking during a panel discussion at the Global 24 conference, also said Europe must, like the United States, look critically at its long-term budget outlook.
"I agree with Hans (Tietmeyer) that in normal times we must be balanced to counter assymetric shocks," Trichet said.
